claim: One anti-PEG positive participant had titres rise at least fourfold by the third dose, returning to baseline by month 12, with reactions on 11 of 43 doses
source_value: One participant positive for anti-PEG at baseline; titres increased at least fourfold in the predose sample for dose 3 (day 52), then gradually decreased and returned to baseline at month 12; experienced grade 1 or 2 IRRs during 11/43 (25.6%) doses; continued treatment and has not experienced IRRs for more than a year
